paraphrase: In the existing two-cohort turnover fixture, every carrier assignment preserving operational continuation as numerical carrier identity has no timeless constituent-extension representation. A constant Unit carrier with time-indexed constituents satisfies continuation and turnover; a phase carrier with fixed constituents satisfies turnover but rejects continuation-as-identity. These logical interpretations neither settle actual river identity nor refute materialism, and do not establish substantial unity or a soul. Root-path open premises: no change.
